title: Module and abelian cohomology over an object of a ringed site agree
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of rings on $\mathcal C$, and $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $M_{ab}$ for the underlying abelian sheaf. Work in a common universe containing the objects, arrows, ring and module values, and covering index sets, and assume the module category has enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ and every integer $q\geq0$, there is a canonical additive isomorphism $$R^q\Gamma_{\mathrm{Mod}}(U,-)(M)\cong H^q(U,M_{ab}),$$ where $\Gamma_{\mathrm{Mod}}(U,-):\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ sends $P$ to $P(U)$, its right derived functors are computed by injective module resolutions, and $H^q(U,-)$ is the right derived functor of evaluation in abelian sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. These isomorphisms are natural in $M$ and are the identity of $M(U)$ in degree zero. No flatness of $\mathcal O$ over the constant integer sheaf and no injectivity of $M_{ab}$ is assumed.
